hook: *18* fake death certificates for living people, Siddipet
hook_b: *18* fake death certificates for living people, Siddipet
tldr: Cherial police booked two people after 18 fake death certificates were allegedly issued using a panchayat official's digital signature.

beats.what: Police suspect the certificates were used to claim insurance on policies taken in relatives' names.
beats.why: The case came from a complaint by the Mandal Panchayat Officer, per Siasat.
beats.care: Police are checking records and whether others were part of the racket.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Siasat: the e-sign dongle is the digital key used to authorise official records.

cards.q: How should digital signatures on government certificates be protected?

qs: How do insurers verify a death certificate before paying?

facts.t: Police booked *2* people: a gram panchayat secretary and an internet centre operator.

viz.l: How the racket worked, per police

learn.t: E-sign dongle = a USB key holding an official's digital signature for approving records.

watch: Whether police find more certificates or people involved.

sources.title: Living declared dead: Fake death certificate racket busted in Telangana

fact: Police found *18* fake death certificates issued for people still alive.
twist: Police say a panchayat secretary's e-sign dongle was handed to a Hyderabad internet centre for a bribe.
